title: 647. Add One Row to Tree

examples.explanation: Every depth-1 node gains a new val-1 child on each side; old subtrees hang below the new row.
Nodes at depth 2 each receive the new row; node 2 keeps 3 under its new left child and 1 under its new right child.
Depth 1 replaces the root with a new node holding 5.
